info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - IP Configuration
info.description:
IP networking configuration for Cisco-IOS-XE-native model. This container includes routing, access-lists, services, DHCP, DNS, NAT, CEF forwarding, IP SLA, and all IPv4-related configuration.

**What's included:** Complete IP configuration hierarchy under /native/ip, plus /native/cef

**Modules covered:** ip (core), Cisco-IOS-XE-cef (CEF forwarding), Cisco-IOS-XE-sla (IP SLA)

**Common use cases:** Static routing, ACLs, IP services, DHCP server, DNS, CEF table tuning, IP SLA probes

**Related:** See 'Router' for dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), 'IPv6' for IPv6 configuration

get.description:
Retrieve Cisco Express Forwarding (CEF) table configuration including output-chain build preferences and consistency checks.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section cef`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-cef

CEF is the default switching path on IOS-XE platforms. This container controls forwarding-table build behaviour, load-sharing hash, and table consistency verification.

get.description:
Retrieve IP Service Level Agreement (SLA) probe configuration for measuring network performance.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section ip sla`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-sla

IP SLA operations include ICMP echo, UDP jitter, HTTP, DNS, TCP connect and more. Used for path verification, VoIP readiness, and tracking.
